about_the_game:
Floorball League 2010

Step onto the court and experience the thrill of floorball with Floorball League 2010 (formerly FBL / Floorball League), the first official 3D floorball video game, originally released in 2010. Dive into fast-paced matches with real teams from the International Floorball Federation and the Finnish Salibandyliiga.

Whether you’re a seasoned player or new to the sport, FBL '10 delivers engaging floorball action with dynamic arenas and multiple ways to play.

Key Features

  • Real Teams and Leagues – Play with authentic teams from top international and Finnish leagues.

  • Multiple Game Modes – Jump into exhibition matches, league play, tournaments, shootouts, or practice in training mode.

  • Singleplayer & Multiplayer – Play solo or compete with friends in local multiplayer.

  • Accessible for Everyone – Easy-to-learn controls make it approachable for newcomers while still offering fun for fans of the sport.

Relive the excitement of floorball in its early digital form, now updated as Floorball League 2010, and lead your team to victory!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo 2.3 GHz or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9 compatible card with 512 MB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 3 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible card with 1 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: The first official floorball video game is back! Play real teams, enter tournaments, and relive the fast-paced action of 2010.

English*, Finnish
